'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Chris Twiss DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Twiss]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: HD(v); list is Endor Operations. Sheet lists 59 Reserve Deck cards (struck line omitted).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Username:''' vader327
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
